claim: The sample transfer finishes with three matching file hashes and a receipt.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; run bundled sample transfer

claim: No account or app is needed.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; assert transfer is ready without identity fields

claim: Friend File Drop is free to use.
sandbox: fresh browser context; assert free copy and no payment action

claim: The demo uses only its session storage namespace and sends no data to third parties.
sandbox: fresh browser context; run demo and inspect all requests, sessionStorage, and IndexedDB

claim: The installed app works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; wait for service worker control, go offline, and reload

claim: A receiver joins a transfer room with the sender's six-word code.
where: transfer workbench, how it works, and README
sandbox: two fresh browser contexts and an isolated room-service fixture; exchange only the displayed six-word code

claim: Room connection details expire after 15 minutes.
where: transfer workbench, privacy page, and README
sandbox: isolated room store with an injected clock; assert present at 14:59.999 and absent at 15:00

claim: Files move directly between connected browsers and both sides get a hash receipt.
where: landing facts, how it works, and README
sandbox: two fresh browser contexts; join by room code, transfer a fixture, verify download and both receipts

claim: A rejoined direct transfer resumes from chunks saved in IndexedDB.
where: transfer status, privacy page, and README
sandbox: seed one verified 32 KB chunk in receiver IndexedDB, rejoin the same room, and assert resume at that offset

claim: Finished receipts are stored in this browser's IndexedDB.
sandbox: fresh sender context; finish a direct transfer and read the receipt object store

claim: The relay starts only after both people choose it and removes file bytes after the receipt.
where: transfer disclosure, privacy page, and README
sandbox: two fresh contexts with an isolated relay fixture; assert one consent waits, two transfer, and receipt clears bytes

claim: The relay limits each room to 25 MB.
where: transfer disclosure, privacy page, and README
sandbox: isolated relay store; fill the exact byte cap and assert the next byte is rejected

claim: The app has no analytics, advertising, third-party runtime scripts, or contact access.
sandbox: fresh privacy-page context; inspect all requests, loaded script/style origins, and contact inputs

claim: Each selected file gets its own verified receipt row, even when two files have identical bytes.
where: landing hero caption and transfer receipt
sandbox: two fresh browser contexts; transfer two differently named files with the same bytes and assert two verified receipt rows

claim: Your own files stay untouched.
sandbox: fresh sender browser; transfer selected fixtures and assert their names and bytes remain in the source input

claim: Exports saved receipts.
sandbox: fresh browser with one local receipt; download the JSON and assert its receipt record

claim: Imports saved receipts.
sandbox: fresh browser with one local receipt; import a valid JSON fixture and assert both records appear

claim: The sample transfer uses no API request or visitor file.
where: demo ready status and demo documentation
sandbox: fresh browser at /demo; run the sample, assert no /api request and no file input

claim: The most recent room code is stored locally until you clear it or make another room.
sandbox: fresh browser with an isolated room fixture; create a room, clear its code, and assert localStorage removal

claim: The managed API exposes a health response with service and build identity.
sandbox: isolated function invocation; assert the public health JSON has service, version, and no-store response policy
